---
title: "About"
---

<div class="about-intro">

My name is Alexandros Rekkas. I hold a PhD in Medical Informatics from
Erasmus University Rotterdam (Erasmus Medical Center). I am currently a
researcher at the Institute of Applied Biosciences (INAB) at the Centre
for Research and Technology Hellas (CERTH).

My research focuses on clinical prediction modeling and the exploration
of treatment effect heterogeneity using machine learning and causal
inference methods. I develop and apply statistical methods to estimate
individualized treatment effects from observational healthcare data,
with the goal of supporting evidence-based, personalized medical
decision-making. My work spans the design and evaluation of prognostic
models, risk stratification tools, and open-source analytics software
for real-world data analysis.

During my PhD, I developed the RiskStratifiedEstimation R package for
the OHDSI (Observational Health Data Sciences and Informatics)
community, which enables standardized assessment of treatment effect
heterogeneity across observational healthcare databases mapped to the
OMOP Common Data Model.

I have contributed to several EU-funded research projects including
EHDEN (European Health Data and Evidence Network), SYNTHIA (synthetic
data generation for AI in healthcare), and Smart Health EDIH (European
Digital Innovation Hub for Smart Health).

</div>
